snippet.description:
Master Partial Differentiation in Calculus! Learn Partial Derivatives, Geometric Meaning, Notations (p, q, r, s, t), and Limits for BSc Maths & Engineering.

Hello Students! Welcome back to Fractal Frontier Maths.

Aaj ke is lecture mein hum Calculus ka ek naya aur bahut important topic shuru kar rahe hain — Partial Differentiation (आंशिक अवकलन).

Agar aap BSc Mathematics ya Engineering ke student hain, toh yeh lecture aapke foundation ko solid banayega. 

Is video mein humne cover kiya hai:

Function of Two Variables (Independent vs Dependent Variables)
Ordinary Derivatives vs Partial Derivatives ka antar 
Partial Derivatives ki Limit Definition
Geometric Interpretation & Section Curves
Standard Notations ($p, q, r, s, t$) & Higher Order Derivatives
Basic Solved Examples

📌 Timestamps:
00:00 – Introduction & Recap of Curvature
00:48 – Single Variable vs Multivariable Functions
03:13 – Why Partial Differentiation is Needed (Real-Life Examples)
06:38 – Physical Example: Temperature Distribution on a Metal Plate
09:10 – Ordinary Derivatives vs Partial Derivatives
11:27 – Why the $\partial$ (del) Notation is Used
14:00 – Limit Definition of Ordinary & Partial Derivatives
20:55 – Geometric Meaning of Functions & Derivatives (Surfaces & Section Curves)
24:31 – Slope of Tangent & Section Curves Explained
31:51 – Basic Example 1: Differentiating $z = x^2 + y^2$
34:07 – Basic Example 2: Handling Mixed Terms ($z = x^2y + 3y^2$)
36:05 – Higher Order Partial Derivatives
39:50 – Standard Monge Notations ($p, q, r, s, t$)
41:37 – Equality of Mixed Partial Derivatives
43:18 – Applications in Science & Real World
44:24 – Summary & What's Next in the Course

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Chord of Curvature | Length of Chord Parallel to Axes & Through Pole → https://youtu.be/_O5EMLr_lr8

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

👍 Like, Share aur Subscribe karna na bhoolein!

#PartialDifferentiation #Calculus #BScMaths #EngineeringMaths #HigherOrderDerivatives #Mathematics #FractalFrontierMaths
